name: Carolina Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: Terry Jacobs and Justin Harper took the belts from Kirk Maclean and Stevie Ray Murdoch at Super Sunday, Bloody Sunday in February 2002 and kept them through the winter; by June Jacobs held them with Kevin Simmons, and The Blood Brothers won them in a three-way at Grand Strand Slam.

name: Piedmont Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The Carolina title for young contenders, formerly the Carolina TV Title. On 3 February 2002 the masked Estoque won it from Dave Pitrelli inside a steel cage and unmasked as Eddie Cutlass; Christian Demonstone was defending it by June.

name: Carolina Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, defended at every big event. Marc Tower, Scott Studd, Eddie Cutlass and Ric Beauty all held it during 2002; Christian Demonstone finally won it from Beauty at Ghosts of RAW on Halloween night.
